answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21072 Country: India Title: Does Sports Allow in Islam? Kindly suggest me with reference Question: Does Sports Allow in Islam? Kindly suggest me with reference Answer ID: 21072 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 447/447/M=1431) If by sport you intend to do exercise and the sport is lawful, there is nothing unlawful in it i.e. opening of satr (hidden parts of body) etc and it does not lead towards laziness and negligence in performing Islamic obligations, then this sport is allowed according to Islam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
